answer: Gate earning behind verifiable apprenticeship: a new identity must complete a long sequence of randomly assigned micro-audits, each planted with a hidden ground-truth case, and pay a small fee per audit that is refunded only after independent witnesses confirm accuracy. One audit suits an honest agent like one pigment suits one canvas, but a farm needs separate fees, separate audit histories and separate correct answers for every clone; copied answers fail the hidden cases, and timber cut to fake a marble record still lacks the lived grain of work done over many epochs.
